new_waiver_completed: a Neon search that times out or fails returns None -> logs 'no account' -> 404; an update that times out or fails -> 200 'success'. Before, a hung Neon ran into the 30 s Lambda limit. Recommend adding the timeout/search case to #99's scope

Timeouts are per request: /reorder submission makes 3 calls in a 10 s function, and no async invoke sets MaximumRetryAttempts, so a Lambda timeout retry could run create_task twice. Follow-up: deadline from context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() or MaximumRetryAttempts: 0

A write that ClickUp or Slack commits after 8 s now counts as a failure (/reorder 'not created'; new purchase request 500 after Slack posted, so a ClickUp retry posts again; new problem report 'Error creating task'). Follow-up: treat ReadTimeout on a write differently
